title: Built in the mountains.
Made for adventure.
about.text: Organix is Stéphane and Bryan. Stéphane has been at the heart of Organix — and of North Macedonia — for around fifteen years. Bryan spent more than a decade in international ski cross, as a member of the Swiss team. Together they bought a snowcat, brought it to North Macedonia and built a permanent local operation with partners on the ground.
